title: SG-7.9 Coding agent provider with a labelled mock, chosen by provider kind
summary: Add a provider package whose mock is clearly labelled, wired to runner.Agent and selected by worker.provider_kind
description: Context: the worker runner (backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go) defines the Agent interface, and config already validates provider_kind as mock or claude. No implementation of Agent exists. Desired behavior: a provider package supplies a mock agent that says it is a mock, a Claude CLI adapter, and a factory that picks one from provider_kind. Expected result: the runner can be built with an Agent chosen from config. Why: mock runs must never be mistaken for real development.
acceptance_criteria: Given provider_kind is mock, When the factory is called, Then it returns the mock agent, which satisfies runner.Agent
Given the mock agent runs, When it finishes, Then the work dir holds a file that states it is a MOCK run and the cost is 0
Given provider_kind is claude, When the factory is called, Then it returns the Claude adapter
Given an unknown provider_kind, When the factory is called, Then it returns an error naming the kind

in_scope: Claude CLI adapter behind an Exec interface
out_of_scope: changes to the runner retry logic

technical_constraints: Never interpolate player text into a shell
The agent is passed arguments as a slice, not a shell string
definition_of_done: All requirements are met and their Verify units pass
non_functional: Mock output must be unmistakably labelled
